findings.description: The assigned nine-rule accounting foundation remains largely unimplemented. Expansion supports only temporal image Evidence with an empty PilotSubmission collection. Video Evidence, nonempty submission collections and all other temporal/warrant roots receive explicit unavailable diagnostics. All 24 broad root-profile controls fail in the supplied round-2 gate. Preserving semantic INCOMPLETE does not satisfy the required prerequisite accounting.

Dependency declarations are still not independently expanded. Evidence fields are enumerated, but MediaAsset is reduced to a hard-coded type read. Fresh direct and in-memory SQLite probes added revision=count and then an absent required_unread=text declaration to MediaAsset. Both audits retained empty diagnostics and usable support; expected MediaAsset paths remained only identity and type. The existing unread-declaration test mutates only Evidence.

Checked optional applicability remains incomplete. Fresh probes on both reader paths confirmed that a submission with frame_indices=[] and derivative=null passes the integrated temporal preparer, while audit rejects the root and records zero checked-inactive obligations. Only Evidence timestamp inactivity is implemented. The binding attachment inactivity requirement and its false-active/false-inactive controls remain absent.

Media-scoped preparation and root classification remain absent. Receipt.classified is never populated; no scope pin or exact membership chain establishes ACTIVE or excluded roots. Receipt.merge concatenates manually supplied receipts, and its test checks selected fields from two independent image audits. This cannot establish complete accounting for every classified root or detect omitted scoped contributions.

Acceptance tests remain failing and incomplete. The focused controls establish an image VALUE omission and selected reconciliation faults, but do not establish warrant-consumer omission sensitivity, complete activation/use/association inventories, the other boundary-mode deletion controls, media-scope accounting or dropped aggregation. Broad root tests assert generic support and nonempty ledgers, rather than independent whole-profile obligations, and all 24 fail. Removing the entire reconciliation function is not a deletion witness for each validator.
